title: Read-only review children cannot run `engram source` for their start/end boundary (Codex sandbox denies Temp writes; Claude read-only Bash refuses engram)
outcome: A read-only /review-code child, Codex or Claude, can run the installed `engram source --root <exact root> --json` to capture the shared source_id at its start and end boundaries, without any write outside the read-only policy, so a review round can verify its freeze under Greg's one-source_id rule.
acceptance: Read-only review children cannot run `engram source` for their start/end boundary (Codex sandbox denies Temp writes; Claude read-only Bash refuses engram) is done
